summary: SIEM feed s063_single is degraded due to complete loss of VLAN visibility: 100% of packets are untagged and required VLANs 10, 20 are not seen. All other checks (duplicates, encrypted share, one-way, oversize, drops, overload, truncated, tunnel) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker egress or TAP/SPAN handoff is stripping 802.1Q tags (e.g., VLAN stripping policy, untagged access port, or SPAN that removes tags) before delivery to the SIEM tool port, so required VLANs 10 and 20 never arrive.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM requires VLANs 10 and 20 for segmentation and correlation. With 100% untagged traffic it cannot attribute events to those VLANs, VLAN-based filtering and detection rules fail, creating a complete blind spot for those segments.

recommended_fix.why: Preserving/restoring 802.1Q tags on the packet broker egress ensures the SIEM receives VLAN 10 and 20 as required for correct classification and detection coverage.
